rationale: Human metabolic-gene knockout screen (~2,980 genes, 30,198 guides, 499 INTERGENIC non-targeting) in Cas9 THP-1-derived macrophages (tMAC) stimulated with LPS+IFN-gamma and sorted into CD80-high and CD80-low pro-inflammatory bins. Per-sample files merged by sgRNA (prepare.R). One library per bin, so run_barcs.R uses the no-replicate path with an overdispersion pooled over the intergenic guides; calls are screening-level. Coefficient is CD80-high vs CD80-low: knockouts that raise CD80 (the paper's CD80-high enriched list: B3GNT8, ST3GAL6, NANS) are enriched, knockouts that lower CD80 (CD80-low enriched: NDUFS6, KEAP1, respiratory-chain and ROS genes) are depleted. The iMAC arm is not analyzed: its deposited bin labels are internally inconsistent (GSM titles swap high/low relative to filenames, both file headers read 'high').
